Title: AKS will stop support for Windows Server 2019 on March 1 2026

Body.Content:
Kubernetes workloads will no longer be supported with Windows Server 2019 when Kubernetes version 1.32 reaches End of Life (EOL) on March 1, 2026. 

Windows Server 2019 will not be available in Kubernetes 1.33 and higher.

Follow the detailed steps in our documentation to transition to Windows Server 2022.
